question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this v1 schema, privacy contract, shard-import policy, and fail-closed filesystem trust model as the durable foundation for later workflow instrumentation?
rationale: The patch creates permanent stored-data and security boundaries whose portability, privacy, retention, and compatibility policy cannot be settled by green tests alone.

options.title: Approve the core contract
options.body: Accept the schema and trust model, then review the stacked instrumentation against the frozen contract.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land only the event model and local immutable spool while deferring import, remote projection, or broader filesystem primitives.

options.title: Pause the ledger direction
options.body: Keep current projections authoritative until maintainers sponsor a different durable-audit architecture.
